title: Lithium supply-chain optimisation - Energies 2024 paper model
description:
The multi-period mixed-integer program behind Jones (2024), Energies 17, 2685: a five-stage global lithium supply chain - mining, processing, cathode, cell, pack - with a recycling loop, solved to 2100 under minimum-cost and minimum-CO2 objectives.

Rebuilding the instance from the shipped data reproduces the paper's stated dimensions exactly (13,556 constraint rows, 10,706 continuous variables). The published objective is an incumbent rather than a proven optimum - the solve terminates on a time limit with a residual gap - so the repository also ships the frozen model instance and its solution, letting anyone verify the published figure with no solver and no commercial licence.

Unfunded work. No grant supported this model.
